chunks: Their deception will not avail them in the least on that day, nor will they be helped.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the schemes of disbelievers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir (or Al-Mir'aj depending on the specific recitation context, often linked to the Day of Judgment) underscores the ultimate futility of human ingenuity against divine decree. It highlights that on the Day of Resurrection, neither political maneuvering nor spiritual intercession will avail those who rejected the truth, serving as a stern warning to the faithful about the transient nature of worldly power.
